$schema: Samidha Reviews design tokens - single source of truth for color, type, spacing, radii. Applied to site/ (static marketing+docs), web/ (React dashboard), and (forward-looking) the HF model card once Wave 3 publishes weights. Every color pair listed under contrastPairs is WCAG-AA-verified by scripts/check_contrast.py, which runs in CI.
concept: Samidha (समिधा) - wood offered to a sacred fire. The mark is four crossed sticks converging into a single rising flame: many scattered raw inputs (reviews) becoming one bright, structured signal.
usageRules: Dark surfaces (marketing hero, dashboard dark mode): background ink, body text flameWhite or smoke, links/accent ember or flameGold.
Light surfaces (docs, dashboard light mode): background paper, body text ink, links/accent emberOnLight (NOT ember - fails AA on paper, see contrastPairs).
Buttons with an ember or flameGold background use ink text, never white/flameWhite text (fails AA - see contrastPairs 'ember-button-white-text').

logDark/logLight are decorative (the mark itself, illustrative wood-tones) - not intended as text/UI colors; not included in contrastPairs for that reason, except the one light-mode caption use below.

knownFailingPairs.name: ember-bg-white-text
knownFailingPairs.rule: Never use white text on an ember background - use ink instead (see usageRules).

knownFailingPairs.name: light-bg-ember-link
knownFailingPairs.rule: Never use raw ember as text/link color on a light/paper background - use emberOnLight instead.

display.role: Headlines, hero text - carries the warmth/craft of the brand.

mono.role: Code, JSON output, review IDs - pairs natively with IBM Plex Sans.
